title: Design: the dialog when a tier with customers is archived
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View' and 'Customers — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, on tier A for work orders only.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Open tier A's three-dot menu.
  3. Click Archive.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows.

Step 2:

  • The menu lists Audit Log, Archive and Delete.

Step 3:

  • A dialog titled tier A's name and "Can't Be Archived Yet" opens.
  • A bold line reads "2 customers are on" and tier A's name.
  • Then it reads "Take them off or move them to another tier first, then archive it. Parts already on their work orders keep their prices."
  • A table with columns Customer and "On" tier A's name "for" lists each customer with "Work orders and Part Sales" or "Work orders only".
  • A blue Remove Customers link sits at the bottom left and a Close button at the bottom right, with an X at the top right, as in picture 2.19.
